theorems.name: Submission.p04_pb_60221840b0_central_telescoping
theorems.statement: ∀ {k X : Type _} [CommRing k] (u v : X → X) (m : ℕ) (c : Fin (m + 1) → X), let Q : Fin (m + 1) → (Fin (m + 2) → X) := fun j => Fin.insertNth j.castSucc (u (c j)) (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => if i < j then u (c i) else v (c i)); (∑ j : Fin (m + 1), (MonoidAlgebra.single (Q j ∘ j.castSucc.succAbove) (1 : k) - MonoidAlgebra.single (Q j ∘ j.succ.succAbove) (1 : k))) = MonoidAlgebra.single (v ∘ c) (1 : k) - MonoidAlgebra.single (u ∘ c) (1 : k)
theorems.natural_summary: The central faces are consecutive transition tuples, so their differences telescope to the endpoint difference.
